input.prompt:
A quiet, real editorial landscape photograph of a lone billboard far out in open country: A lone billboard stands on bare steel scaffolding far out in the steppe; beside it stands an empty scaffold frame with no board.

The output is one single photograph, landscape 4:3.

Shot: Camera at standing height, 50mm lens, f/8, almost square to the board. The billboard sits a little right of centre, filling about 35 percent of the frame width, sharp, raised on its thin legs and diagonal braces; the empty scaffold frame stands at the left edge; tawny grass and scrub in soft focus in the foreground; low mountains and a line of clouds on the horizon; generous blue sky above. Nobody is in frame.

Place: Vast open steppe: flat dry scrubland of tawny grass and low grey-green bushes, a few thin wooden fence posts, low brown mountains along the horizon; no buildings, no town.

Light: Warm low late-afternoon sun from one side, raking across the grass and lighting the board face fully; long soft shadows; a soft blue sky with a few scattered white cumulus clouds along the horizon.

Palette and grade: Natural, slightly muted film colour: tawny ochre grass, olive scrub, dusty brown hills, soft blue sky, white clouds; the design surface clean neutral white in the warm light. The same grade on every image of this set.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph of out-of-home advertising, so the design surface is the hero: it is clearly the subject of the photograph, standing on the centre line at a medium size in a wide, calm landscape. It is an unstaged photograph of a real place on a real day, with the place clean and well kept, no dirt, grime, stains or graffiti; the design surface itself is new, flat and clean. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are in frame. The design surface is bright and clean without blowing out; its edges and corners stay crisp.

Design surface: THE BILLBOARD FACE IS PLAIN MATTE WHITE, flat and taut edge to edge with crisp corners on its simple frame, lit by the low sun, nothing printed on it and nothing crossing it.

Finish: Shot on medium-format film like a calm documentary landscape series: fine natural grain, soft contrast, gentle colour, honest exposure; real and unstaged, never a render, never HDR.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, any image or text on the billboard, buildings, towns or roads unless the shot names them, an HDR or over-saturated look, a clean smooth 3D render look.
